guide.summary: Prototype on Composio managed app (approval path unconfirmed); Own app for customers (partner program) (partner acceptance). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.
guide.verdict: Own app for customers (partner program) (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio lists a managed OAuth app for Greenhouse. For launch with your own branding, create a custom auth config with the client ID and secret Greenhouse issues, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype: Composio's managed app works. For production under your own brand, scopes and quota you need your own credentials, which Greenhouse only issues to accepted partners.
reasons: Consent screen shows 'Composio wants to access your account' with the managed app
Managed app default scopes may not cover what you need
Managed apps share rate-limit quota across all Composio users
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum trigger polling interval

prerequisites.title: At least one mutual customer
prerequisites.detail: The request cannot be submitted without one.

prerequisites.title: Website with Privacy Policy
prerequisites.detail: You must have an active website with a Privacy Policy to apply.

prerequisites.title: Customers on new Greenhouse tiers
prerequisites.detail: Harvest v3 partner integrations are available only on Core, Plus and Pro.

prerequisites.title: Logo, scopes and callback URL ready
prerequisites.detail: Greenhouse needs a 128x128 logo, the integration name, the exact scopes and your redirect URL(s).

steps.title: Prototype with Composio managed Greenhouse
steps.detail: Create a connection using Composio's managed Greenhouse auth config through the Composio API.
steps.done_when: A test user can connect Greenhouse.

steps.title: Draft application and scope list
steps.detail: Draft the integration description and goals, the minimal scope list, integration name and callback URLs.
steps.done_when: Draft is ready for you to review.

steps.title: Submit integration request form
steps.detail: Submit the form with your mutual customer and website details. Submission does not confirm approval.

steps.title: Wait for monthly review and decision
steps.detail: Reviews run the first Monday monthly; Partnerships replies within 7 business days. Do not start integration steps before official confirmation.
steps.done_when: You are invited to sign the Partnership Agreement.

steps.title: Sign the Partnership Agreement
steps.detail: A signed agreement is required before any integration steps.

steps.title: Request credentials from Partner Support
steps.detail: Email Partner Support with name, 128x128 logo, scopes, redirect URI(s) and testing vs production.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret; copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard so it matches what Greenhouse registered.
steps.done_when: Test user connects via your app.

steps.title: Test callback and notify Greenhouse
steps.detail: Once the callback works, send Greenhouse support the final redirect URI.

steps.title: Submit for review and list in directory
steps.detail: The integration is submitted for review before launch in the Partner Directory. Timing and criteria were not found.
steps.done_when: Listed in the Greenhouse Partner Directory.

traps.title: Acceptance is not guaranteed
traps.detail: Every submission is reviewed but not all are accepted, and you must wait for official confirmation before proceeding.

traps.title: Monthly review cadence
traps.detail: Missing the first-Monday review can add about a month. Out-of-cycle requests are generally only for urgent mutual-customer needs.

traps.title: Tokens expire quickly
traps.detail: The authorization code lasts 1 minute and access tokens 1 hour. Refresh tokens expire after 14 days unused, forcing the user to re-authorize.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: Greenhouse registers it and rejects mismatches with invalid_request. Scopes not permitted for your client return invalid_scope.

traps.title: 403 even after authorization
traps.detail: The authorizing user may lack in-app Greenhouse permissions for an action, causing HTTP 403.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding and shared quota
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account', quota is shared across Composio users, and trigger polling is at least 15 minutes.

blockers.what_it_means: The client ID is not configured for this OAuth flow on Greenhouse's side.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Greenhouse Partner Support to fix the configuration.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the support email with client ID and flow details.

blockers.symptom: Application not accepted or no reply
blockers.what_it_means: Greenhouse may decide the integration does not fit the program.
blockers.what_to_do: Wait for the Partnerships reply; consider the managed app meanwhile.
blockers.agent_can_help: Rewrite the application to clarify program fit and customer need.

open_questions: How long do the agreement, credential issuance and Partner Directory review take? Ask Greenhouse Partner Support.
Does the directory review apply to every integration or only to listing? Ask Partnerships.
Can Composio's managed app serve production customers outside your company? Ask Composio support.
Which scopes would a typical agent need, and do any trigger extra review? Not stated; ask Partner Support.
Is a Site Admin required for each customer to connect? Depends on your design; the Greenhouse help article says the partner decides.
